artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Overlay grammar '<email> <tool> [client=<id>]'. _load_overlay() returns (unqualified scopes, identity -> {tool: admitted client_ids}); a qualified row makes its identity scoped and admits its tool only when the request's verified client_id equals <id>; no client -> no admit; a malformed third token admits nothing. _load_scopes() keeps its email -> frozenset(tool) shape (unqualified rows + seed). check(email, tool, client_id=None) reads context.get_current_client_id() when no argument is passed, so the three call sites (tools._run, integrations.base.run_integration_tool, asker_scope.effective_scope) are unchanged. The seed is untouched. Not deployed: the deploy is OA-f-2.

New contextvar _current_client_id (default ''), set only by set_current_principal(principal, client_id='') -- every call resets it -- and cleared by set_current_email (the GUI path has no OAuth client). get_current_client_id() is the one reader.

_bearer_auth(request) returns (principal, the validated token's client_id claim or '' when absent or not a string); the /mcp GuardMiddleware sets both with set_current_principal(principal, client_id) at the same point the principal was set before. _bearer_principal is its principal half, so /teams/poll and /query/v0 are unchanged and carry no client. Scratch probe (not committed; oauth_as.validate_access_token stubbed): claim 'mcp-probe' -> client_id 'mcp-probe' in context; claim absent -> ''; claim 123 -> ''.
